decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship line that stayed visibly promoted in 2024 and fits the firm's core organic dairy competence, management is likely to justify and continue the investment rather than withdraw it.

This 2024 cheese launch is close to the established business and still very recent, so sunk launch costs and the absence of clear failure signals make continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.

Because this 2024 sliced butter cheese is adjacent to the firm's traditional dairy range and has only just been introduced, management would likely give it more time and keep it unless disappointing results become unmistakable.
